notes.title: 9.5 Demo Update
notes.content:
1. Newly added buildings - Marching Grain, Family Mansion, Flag Bearer Camp

2. New units added on the player side - Family Soldier, Flag Bearer

3. Partial unit animation adjustment

4. Increase the attribute of thorns and mark them for differentiation when damaged by thorns

notes.title: 8.13 Demo Update
notes.content:
1. Adjusted the attribute allocation ratio of all units, slightly increasing the growth intensity of health

2. New player side unit - Heavy Cavalry, formed by combining warrior camps and stables

3. Enemy side newly added units - Pregnant Poison Spider and Spiderling

4. Added blood bar style to highlight high-level monsters

notes.title: 7.23 Demo Update
notes.content:
1. The current version number is displayed in the bottom right corner of the main page

2. When monsters appear on the battlefield, the monster icon is displayed in the upper right corner

3. Obtained Black Flame Crystals on the battlefield, with the acquisition quantity displayed on the right side of the resource bar
